prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Miami. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — to give you the best, specific orthodontist recommendations I need a couple quick details. Please tell me:

1) Which part of Miami are you closest to or prefer (Downtown, Brickell, Coral Gables, Miami Beach, Doral, Kendall, etc.)?  
2) Are you an adult or a child/teen?  
3) Do you prefer clear aligners (Invisalign) or are you open to traditional braces (metal/ceramic/lingual)?  
4) Do you have dental insurance or a budget range?  
5) Any complexity (e.g., bite/surgery needed, TMJ issues, crowded teeth, previous braces relapse)?

If you want recommendations right away without those details, I can still give a short list of how to pick and the best places to search (and then produce a tailored list when you tell me area/age/insurance). Which would you prefer?

Quick checklist and resources while you decide:
- Look for board-certified orthodontists (American Board of Orthodontics) — certification signals higher training/standards.  
- Use the AAO “Find an Orthodontist” and Invisalign’s provider locator to find local clinicians with Invisalign experience.  
- Prefer providers with many before/after photos, clear pricing/payment plans, and good recent patient reviews.  
- Ask these questions when you call: Are you board-certified? How many Invisalign cases do you treat each year? Do you offer a free/low-cost consult and digital scans (iTero)? What’s an estimated cost and length of treatment? Any financing/insurance plans?  
If you tell me your neighborhood and preferences I’ll return a short list (3–6) of specific Miami orthodontists/clinics to call with reasons for each.
